conf.description: M365 UAL exchange-online api-pull: Graph audit-query JSON parse, common-field rename, RecordType/clientIp/email transforms, unmapped fields to o365.audit.*

conf.comment: M365 UAL exchange-online, api-pull format (Graph /security/auditLog/queries async flow). Cribl REST Collector already lifted auditData for the field-table view; this pipeline extracts the JSON record, renames the straightforward common-schema fields, maps auditLogRecordType's string enum member to the numeric RecordType (1/2/50 per the map; exchangeItemGroup and exchangeAggregatedOperation are undocumented numerically and fall to -1, a documented gap), splits clientIp's optional port/bracket before mapping to source.ip, derives user.email from userPrincipalName, and routes userType/userId/objectId/administrativeUnits/auditData to custom o365.audit.* fields per the map (status: unmapped). Per direct.cribl: pass through with _raw intact for downstream dedupe-on-id; no extra tagging is called for on this format.

functions.description: parse the Graph auditLogRecord JSON the REST Collector delivered in _raw
batch rename of straightforward mapped/partial fields to their ECS targets
canonical event time in _time (never @timestamp; Elastic dest maps it)
computed transforms, custom-field routing, and event.dataset
